title: Совет от Макса и знакомство с мамой Насти  (Advice from Max and Meeting Nastya's Mom)

segments.t: Looking at Elena's glamorous magazine photo in the office, Max suggests that Chef Barinov has a crush on her and wants to ask her out on a date, earning himself an immediate boot out the door. Out in the dining room, Nastya nervously introduces Kostya to her mother.
Кстати, когда будете приглашать его на свидание, скажите.
Alright, let's go through it step by step in English.
'And this is a woman.' Notice how Russian expresses 'and' and 'woman' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Beautiful and intelligent.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'pretty', while 'clever' completes the thought.
'I like her too.' Notice how Russian expresses 'for me' and 'pleases' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Max answers right away.
Кстати, когда будете приглашать его на свидание, скажите.
'By the way, when you ask her out on a date, let me know.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'by the way' before landing on 'say'.
'What did you just say?' Chef Viktor addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'what'.
'What date are you talking about?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'date'. Max answers right away.
'Chef, I just want to help.' Max brings out the contrast between 'chef' and 'I' in a few short words.
'Get the hell out of here.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'go', while 'from here' completes the thought.
'Get out, I said!' Kostya anchors the line on 'go', while 'to say' completes the thought. Max answers right away.
'Mom, this is my Kostya.' Max anchors the line on 'mum', while 'Kostya' completes the thought.
'This is my mother.' Chef Barinov centers this short reply on 'mum', letting a few direct words carry the whole meaning.
'Very nice to meet you.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'very' before landing on 'pleasant'. Max answers right away.
'It is very nice to meet you too.' The grammar packs 'for me' and 'pleasant' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's listen to all those lines again from the top.
Кстати, когда будете приглашать его на свидание, скажите.
That wraps up this scene as max teases Chef Barinov about wanting to ask Elena out on a date, and in the dining room Nastya introduces Kostya to her mother. See you next time!
